units.text: INT. JUNE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT
Posters, fairy lights, a pile of laundry that is definitely not just laundry.
JUNE PARK, 16, sits on the bed in pajamas with her best friend WESLEY, 17, and her little brother BEN, 9, who is holding a flashlight he was told not to touch.
Okay so the rule is nobody screams. If somebody screams we all die.
units.name: JUNE
paren: whispering, tugging a blanket over all three of them

units.text: That is not how that works.
units.name: WESLEY

units.text: It is exactly how that works.
units.name: BEN
paren: clicking the flashlight on and off

units.text: The phone BUZZES on the nightstand.
June jumps.
Wesley shrieks and ducks under a pillow.
You screamed!
units.name: JUNE

units.text: I did not scream I sneezed in a very high register.
units.name: WESLEY

units.text: ON PHONE: "MOM: Honey are you asleep?
Door's locked right?"
Mom is checking on me. Act asleep.
units.name: JUNE
paren: texting back with her thumbs flying

units.text: Zzzz. Zzzz. Why am I the one doing the snoring?
units.name: BEN

units.text: Because you're the most convincing.
units.name: WESLEY

units.text: A door SLAMS somewhere in the house.
All three freeze.
June? Is that you in the hall?
units.name: MOM
paren: through the phone, tinny, on speaker now

units.text: Mom, I'm in my room.
units.name: JUNE
paren: going pale, the phone trembling in her hand

units.text: Then who just walked past my door?
units.name: MOM

units.text: The closet door CREAKS open.
From the shadows, a tall figure in a shower curtain hobbles out, dragging one foot, groaning.
AUNT LIN, 40s, June's aunt, ghoul makeup smeared, grinning.
Surprise! Happy Halloween eve!
units.name: AUNT LIN

units.text: I hate this family!
units.name: WESLEY

units.text: Aunt Lin! You almost killed us!
units.name: JUNE
paren: laughing, hitting her with the blanket

units.text: You look dead. It's great.
units.name: BEN
paren: shining the flashlight in her face

units.text: I've been rehearsing since Tuesday.
units.name: AUNT LIN
paren: accepting a pillow to the face

units.text: I told her not to. Goodnight, everyone.
units.name: MOM
